newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai woollen sweater firm goes bankrupt.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai woollen sweater firm goes bankrupt.

text.p: The Shanghai Number 8 Woollen Sweater company has been declared bankrupt, the Wen Hui Bao newspaper reported on Thursday.
The 50-year-old state-owned factory, which had fallen into losses in recent years with debts exceeding assets by more than 15 million yuan, filed with a local court for bankruptcy in March, it said.

The court ruled that, after paying off essential expenditure, the factory has assets of only 5.6 million yuan, for which the first claim will go to the workers, the newspaper said without giving any more details.
